package: K01-T3 published video playback API after Studio multipart upload

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 after all 84 Prisma migrations; container stopped and removed
flow: owner starts Studio multipart upload and uploads source through signed part PUT
complete endpoint validates uploaded MP4 and requests publish-after-ready
actual scripts/video-worker.ts encodes the uploaded source and finalizes SELF_HLS
video reaches PUBLISHED and has one active playback route and READY SELF_HLS asset
guest media-source API returns READY with access allowed and SELF_HLS source
local edge worker returns master/variant manifests and a non-empty segment from encoded objects

limitations: The S3-compatible object store is a loopback fixture, not Cloudflare R2; the Worker is invoked locally, not deployed.

A Chromium attempt did not produce usable browser playback evidence: the local Next page did not attach a video element during the attempt, and browser requests showed ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED. The attempted browser assertions were removed; no claim of browser playback or decode is made.
Full K01-T3/K35 role/state matrix, other browsers, live provider, operational rollout and independent review remain open.
